verdict_summary: Goodbudget is a strong pick for budgeters who like the envelope method and want to keep costs low or stay fully manual. The free tier is genuinely usable, with 20 envelopes, one account, two devices, and one year of history, and because it requires no bank connection you never share credentials, a real privacy benefit. Paid Premium is $10/month or $80/year and unlocks unlimited envelopes, unlimited accounts, five devices, seven years of history, and automatic bank sync for US banks (as of 2026-07-12). The trade-offs are clear: the free tier has no automatic bank sync, so you enter transactions manually or import CSV, the envelope method takes some learning, and the interface feels dated next to Monarch or Copilot. Goodbudget states it uses bank-grade 256-bit SSL and does not sell personal information, per its official help documentation. For intentional, envelope-style budgeting on a budget, it is a solid, honest choice.
